scope: Annotation coverage only; no model fitting, predictions, or proof that memory is necessary

definitions.gap: Consecutive occluded frames strictly between two visible observations, after first-visible query
definitions.events: Only the first visible frame after each gap; counts are correlated across tracks and videos
definitions.trailing: Occlusion continuing to the video end, right-censored and excluded from reappearance counts
definitions.query_to_end: Potential history age, not a period during which a point is invisible
definitions.time_units: Frames only; no FPS or timestamps inferred from arrays
definitions.clusters: Exact RGB SHA256; different annotations for identical RGB remain separate official examples
